name: Severe Toxic Smog & AQI 480+ Emergency
description: Hazardous post-harvest stubble burning and meteorological inversion cause unprecedented smog, triggering Stage-IV GRAP emergency measures.

synthesis.title: Severe Toxic Smog & Hazardous AQI Spike in Delhi-NCR
severityFactors: AQI cross 480 in Rohini & Jahangirpuri (Severe+ category)
Visibility below 50 meters on Outer Ring Road and NH-48
GRAP Stage IV emergency curbs in effect across entire NCR
Respiratory emergency alert issued by Safdarjung Hospital
synthesis.summary: Air Quality Index (AQI) has reached hazardous levels (480-495) across Delhi-NCR due to zero wind velocity and temperature inversion. Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) has invoked Stage IV of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP-IV). Non-BS-VI diesel vehicles and non-essential trucks are prohibited from entering Delhi. All schools have suspended physical classes.

confirmedFacts.fact: GRAP Stage-IV restrictions formally enforced by CAQM across Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, and Faridabad.
All schools up to Grade 9 shifted to online classes until further notice.
Entry of non-electric/non-CNG commercial trucks banned into Delhi.

reportedInformation.claim: Massive pile-ups reported on Outer Ring Road near Mukarba Chowk due to near-zero visibility.
Private corporate offices in Cyber City Gurgaon reportedly mandated 50% work-from-home.

uncertainties.item: Duration of severe temperature inversion layer
uncertainties.reason: IMD forecasts calm wind conditions persisting for at least 36 to 48 hours.

uncertainties.item: Whether odd-even private vehicle rules will be enacted tomorrow
uncertainties.reason: Cabinet meeting scheduled for 3:00 PM today to deliberate.

sourceB.says: Interstate commercial passenger diesel carriers restricted at border checkpoints

conflictingReports.note: Official checkpoint enforcement at Kapashera and Sirhaul borders is strictly turning back diesel buses. Commuters should rely strictly on Delhi Metro Yellow Line.

recommendedActions.action: Run HEPA air purifiers indoors and keep windows tightly sealed
recommendedActions.basis: Central Pollution Control Board health advisory

affectedLocations.explanation: Rohini monitoring station reports PM2.5 at 488 (Severe+). Hazardous smog will penetrate homes without air purifiers. Keep windows shut and use wet towel door seals.
Offices remain open under advisory, but border checkpoint congestion on NH-48 is causing 90+ minute delays for road transport.
Your road transit path via Ring Road & NH-48 is hazardous due to near-zero visibility and border truck diversions. Switch directly to Delhi Metro Yellow Line (Samaypur Badli to Sikanderpur).

If your employer allows, work remotely. For mandatory travel to Cyber City, take the Delhi Metro Yellow Line only.

sources.title: CAQM Official Directive: Enforcement of GRAP Stage-IV in National Capital Region
sources.rawContent: In view of the deteriorating air quality in Delhi-NCR, CAQM hereby imposes GRAP Stage IV with immediate effect. All construction activities, non-BS-VI diesel vehicles, and non-essential commercial vehicles are banned.

sources.title: Delhi Traffic Police: Visibility Advisory and Interstate Checkpoints
sources.rawContent: Visibility dropped under 50m on NH-48 and Ring Road. Non-essential commercial vehicles diverted at border points. Motorists advised to use fog lights and avoid high speeds.

sources.title: Citizen Report: Outer Ring Road Near Mukarba Chowk Traffic Jam
sources.rawContent: Multiple cars bumped into each other near Mukarba flyover. Smog is stinging eyes and throat. Traffic is at a complete standstill.
